REGULAR MEETING AGENDA
CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS
AND THE SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY
THURSDAY - JULY 11, 2019 - CITY HALL -
07:00 P.M.
City Council Chamber
AGENDA MATERIALS: Reports and materials related to items on this Agenda are available for public inspection at the City Clerk's Office, Cerritos City Hall, 18125 Bloomfield Avenue, Cerritos, CA 90703, during normal business hours, 8 a.m. to 5 p.m., Monday through Friday, Telephone (562) 916-1248. Materials submitted to the City Council/Successor Agency after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection in the City Clerk's Office at the above address during normal business hours as noted.
PUBLIC COMMENTS: For all Agenda Items, except for Consent Calendar Items, public comments will be allowed at the time each matter comes up for discussion. Please complete and submit a blue Speaker's Card to ensure that you are recognized when the Agenda item is considered. The general public comments portion of the meeting, under Agenda Item 6, will not exceed 45 minutes, and no speaker will be allowed more than five minutes, unless determined appropriate by the Chair. To assist in the preparation of appropriate responses, persons are requested, but not required, to state their name and city of residence for the record.
PUBLIC HEARINGS: Public hearings will be conducted in the order indicated on the agenda, unless otherwise directed. Please complete and submit a blue Speakers Card if you wish to present testimony. Conduct of public hearings will occur in substantially the following sequence: the item to be heard is announced, a report of written correspondence and staff report are received, and the City Council asks questions of staff. The public hearing is opened and verbal testimony will occur in the following order: the applicant, if applicable, those in favor, opposed, or interested parties, and rebuttal by applicant. Speakers are requested, but not required, to state their name and city of residence for the record. After verbal testimony, the public hearing is closed and the matter is deliberated with a determination being made or a continuation of the matter.

Public Comments and Suggestions
This section is reserved for comments related to Consent Calendar Items and items not listed on the Agenda but within the subject matter jurisdiction of the City Council/Successor Agency. Comments are limited to 5 minutes per person.
7.
Consent Calendar
Items under the Consent Calendar are considered routine and will be enacted by one motion. Subject to the discretion of the City Council/Successor Agency, there will be no separate discussion of these items unless a Council/Agency Member or citizen so requests, in which event the item may be removed from the Consent Calendar and considered separately.
7A.
Approval of Minutes
Approval of the City Council/Successor Agency Special Meeting Minutes of June 24, 2019 (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY).
Minutes
7B.

Review and consideration of the City of Cerritos 2019 Public Health Goal Report (COUNCIL).
Agenda Report
9.
New and Old Business

Review and consideration of an informational update on the March 3, 2020 City of Cerritos General Municipal Election and presentation regarding the Los Angeles County Voting Solutions for All People (VSAP) project (COUNCIL).
Agenda Report
10.
Legislative Items
10A.
Report on pending legislation.
10B.
Review and consideration to support or oppose specific legislation in the State or Federal legislature or in the State or Federal Executive Office for signature.
11.
City Council Communications/Committee Reports/Report on Meetings
During this part of the meeting members of the City Council report to the community on various matters of interest, including reports concerning committees on which the Councilmembers serve and reports on meetings/conferences attended. In addition, requests may be made of the staff for reports which will be presented to the City Council at a subsequent meeting, or for the scheduling of future agenda items. There will be no discussion or action taken on any of the items that may be presented during this agenda item.
12.
Closed Session
13.
Adjournment

MINUTES OF A REGULAR MEETING OF THE CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL AND THE
SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY HELD ON
JULY 11, 2019, IN THE COUNCIL CHAMBER AT CERRITOS CITY HALL, 18125
BLOOMFIELD AVENUE, CERRITOS, CALIFORNIA

1.  Call to Order

  The meeting was called to order at 7:00 p.m.

2.  Invocation

  The invocation was given by Vida Barone, City Clerk.

3.  Pledge of Allegiance

  The Pledge of Allegiance was led by Cerritos Recreation Services Youth Soccer
  League Pee Wee Team, “Fire.”

4.  Roll Call

  The following members of the City Council/Successor Agency were in attendance:

  Council/Agency Member Jim Edwards
  Council/Agency Member Grace Hu
  Council/Agency Member Mark E. Pulido
  Mayor Pro Tem/Vice Chair Frank A. Yokoyama
  Mayor/Chair Naresh Solanki

5.  Presentations/Appointments

5A.  Presentations

  None.

6.  Public Comments and Suggestions

  Mayor Solanki read a statement into the record regarding the City Council’s
  expectation of meeting decorum and its rejection of profane or hateful speech in
  public meetings.

  Jane Hwang spoke regarding her interest in proposing a project for the Mullikin
  Building. She submitted a document for the record.

  Kevin Roh spoke in support of speaker Jane Hwang.

  Artellia Johnson spoke in support of speaker Jane Hwang.

  Ahriell Johnson spoke in support of speaker Jane Hwang.

  Tim Golden spoke in support of speaker Jane Hwang.

  Joseph Pyo spoke in support of speaker Jane Hwang.

6.  Public Comments and Suggestions (continued)

  Herman spoke regarding the first amendment. He submitted a document for the

  Armando Cepeda requested reconsideration of the proposed first responders
  sculpture.

  Paul W. Bellenbaum spoke regarding the design of the American flag.

7.  Consent Calendar

7A.  Approval of Minutes

  Approval of the City Council/Successor Agency Special Meeting Minutes of
  June 24, 2019 (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY).

  MOTION: It was moved by Pulido, and seconded by Edwards, to approve the City

  The motion carried (5 - 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Edwards, Hu, Pulido, Yokoyama, Solanki
  NOES:  None

  ABSTAIN:  None

8.  Public Hearings

8A.  Review and consideration of the City of Cerritos 2019 Public Health Goal Report
  (COUNCIL).

  A staff report was given by Bob Ortega, Water Superintendent.

  The Mayor opened public comments.

  Herman spoke regarding water contamination in Los Angeles County.

  Noting there were no further individuals who elected to speak, the Mayor closed
  public comments.

  MOTION: It was moved by Pulido, and seconded by Hu, to direct staff to send
  confirmation to the appropriate regulatory agencies that the City of Cerritos 2019
  Public Health Goal Report has been completed and a public hearing has been held
  (COUNCIL).

  The motion carried (5 - 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Edwards, Hu, Pulido, Yokoyama, Solanki

  ABSTAIN:  None

9.  New and Old Business

9A.  Review and consideration of an informational update on the March 3, 2020 City of

  A staff report was given by Vida Barone, City Clerk, and a report was given by
  Aaron Nevarez, Governmental and Legislative Affairs Manager, Los Angeles County
  Registrar-Recorder/County Clerk’s Office. PowerPoint presentations were displayed.

  The Mayor opened public comments.

  Herman spoke regarding voting in the community.

  Paul Bellenbaum spoke regarding voting in the community.

  Noting there were no further individuals who elected to speak, the Mayor closed
  public comments.
